designDecisionsAndRationale: Wide-aware measurement is lint-side only, in a helper the export never imports, because changing wrapTextLines would change export wrapping and golden output (user-qa Q2).
Widening page kinds is a constant change because the CLI lint filter (commands.ts:291-296) and export gate (export-command.ts:337) already read TEXT_LAYOUT_LINT_PAGE_KINDS.
Tests that used freeform as the not-lintable control switch to uml pages; page kind does not affect rendering, so byte-equality references still hold.
tll-11 depends on tll-10 because mise run test-cli runs all of bun test apps/cli/src, including the tll-10-owned tests.
The native CLI runs the same TS bundle in Boa with an Intl.Segmenter shim, so no Rust change; parity is proven by an appended native-parity block.
intentionalTradeoffs: Ambiguous (A) width graphemes are treated as narrow.
Existing freeform/flowchart/architecture documents with wide text may get new warning-only findings; export bytes and exit codes are unchanged.
Serial waves trade parallelism for gates that never depend on a later plan.

outOfScopeEdgeCases: Real per-font glyph metrics, kerning and Ambiguous-width locale handling.
UML, ERD, sequence, usecase, state and other page kinds; --element and non-svg/png/pdf export warnings (Q3); export --strict (Q4).
